lastResponse.text: You’re being smart about this. To avoid brochure-and-waitlist loops, call 5 4 1 … 6 8 7 … 2 6 6 7 and screen fast: “Before intake, do you do line-by-line SSA denial review and direct appeal writing for adults with mixed physical and mental health diagnoses?” If they hesitate, ask who on staff does appeals and request that person by name. If you want, I can give you a 15-second script that filters weak referrals in one call.
